- Police rape, assault, extortion of trans people (2009 report — dated, ~17 years old).
- Impunity: institutions fail to investigate/prosecute — major obstacles to justice.
- Trans women held in men's prisons; forced hair cutting, dehumanizing; rape with guard complicity, prosecutors don't investigate (2020). - Documented killings: 2 activist killings 2022; raw counts no denominators → per rule 16, treat as background violence not trans-specific campaign. - Same-sex marriage ban — resident-facing, climate only.
- No documented street violence against visitors specifically; violence is largely local sphere (sex work, activists).
